verified_facts.text: For more than 38 years the property was known as The Four Seasons Resort at Las Colinas.
verified_facts.excerpt: For more than 38 years, this property was known as The Four Seasons Resort at Las Colinas.

verified_facts.text: A $55 million transformation of the resort, now managed by Ritz-Carlton, wrapped up in Spring 2024.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is now being managed by the Ritz Carlton after a $55 million transformation that wrapped up in Spring 2024.

verified_facts.text: The guest rooms were refreshed by the design firms Jeffrey Beers International and Leo A Daly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Led by design firms Jeffrey Beers International and Leo A Daly, the 427 guest rooms got a refresh

verified_facts.text: Club level access is now an option, with a dedicated concierge and a lounge that has a view of the resort pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: club level access is now an option which gets guests a dedicated concierge, gourmet culinary and a gorgeous lounge that has a great view of the resort pool.

verified_facts.text: The resort is set across 400 acres in the heart of Las Colinas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set across 400 acres in the heart of Las Colinas, The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas is a luxury resort near Dallas

verified_facts.text: TPC Las Colinas is an 18-hole, par-70 championship golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury resort near DFW has an 18-hole, par-70 championship course offering opportunities to encounter nature and wildlife while playing.

verified_facts.text: The Dining Room at The Ritz-Carlton serves Italian-inspired cuisine, Texas steaks and seafood, and has a raw bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring Italian-inspired cuisine, premium Texas steaks, pristine seafood, and a vibrant raw bar.

verified_facts.text: Aire Libre blends Texas flavors with Baja coastal cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: This DFW-area restaurant blends bold Texas flavors with the fresh zest of Baja’s coastal cuisine

verified_facts.text: Bar Juniper is in the hotel lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bar Juniper takes center stage in the lobby.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa has a full-service hair and nail salon.
verified_facts.excerpt: With 20 treatment rooms, a full-service hair and nail salon, cold plunge pool, steam room, and nourishing cuisine

verified_facts.text: The spa has a cold plunge pool and a steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: With 20 treatment rooms, a full-service hair and nail salon, cold plunge pool, steam room, and nourishing cuisine

verified_facts.text: The Villas overlook TPC Las Colinas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking TPC Las Colinas, The Villas at The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas are the epitome of intimate escapes.

verified_facts.text: The Poolside Villa has a terrace that opens directly into the resort pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: this villa features a terrace that opens directly into the resort pool

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is the largest suite, in the tower, with views of Downtown Las Colinas, TPC Las Colinas and the resort pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our largest suite, The Ritz-Carlton Suite provides sweeping views of Downtown Las Colinas, TPC Las Colinas and the resort pool.

verified_facts.text: The resort holds a 2026 Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice Award.
The hotel does not provide shuttle service from the airports.
